description.value: The Clouds Vietnamese Cuisine is a sit-down Vietnamese restaurant on Victoria Drive in East Vancouver, serving a full dine-in menu alongside bubble tea. The restaurant also offers takeout, making it a practical stop for cyclists passing through the neighbourhood. It sits on a busy arterial route that connects several residential communities in South Vancouver.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website fully corroborates the OSM contact details (address, phone, name). The OSM tag 'takeaway=yes' and the website's separate Eat and Drink pages confirm dine-in and takeout service including bubble tea. No evidence on the website or in OSM tags addresses bike parking, water refill, washrooms, Wi-Fi, or any other cycling-specific amenities, so those fields are null.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: The business is clearly operational and a legitimate Food & Drink stop, but none of the key WWC required criteria (bike parking/visibility, water refill, washrooms) can be confirmed from the available website content. A site visit or direct contact is needed to verify cycling-relevant amenities before listing.

wow_evidence: sit-down Vietnamese restaurant on Victoria Drive in East Vancouver
